en: The postcard features a black and white aerial photograph of a city with railyards, waterfront, buildings, and trains. The foreground contains train tracks converging by the water, with several trains and industrial buildings visible. Handwritten text overlays the image. The bottom text reads: 'SUNDSVALL. UTSIKT FRÅN GASVERKSSKORSTENEN,' which translates to 'Sundsvall. View from the gasworks chimney.' The reverse side shows a handwritten message in Swedish, Swedish postage stamps, and an address.
